title: The Confidence view lets you colour, ghost and fade each grade
items: In the Navigator's Confidence view, tap a grade's look to open its row: four colour swatches, Tint, Ghost or Dither, and an opacity slider from 0 to 100 %. Each change shows in the town at once.
A Colour-blind-safe colours button puts blue, yellow and vermilion on Attested, Inferred and Reconstructed in one tap, and the presets keep them.
Each row still has its Show switch and the number of structures standing at that grade.
